candidates.description: This vector represents demographic and life-event statistics related to human populations and socioeconomic status.
This feature vector represents legal and legislative instruments, including laws, statutes, rules, and official policies.
This feature vector represents the concept of frequency, prevalence, or common occurrence.
This vector activates on numerical statistics, ratings, rankings, and mathematical measurements.
This feature vector represents entities, infrastructure, and structural systems across diverse domains.
This feature vector activates on adverbs of degree, scope, and qualification that modify emphasis or exclusivity.
This feature vector represents the concept of prohibition, restriction, and opposition.
This feature vector activates strongly on degree and extent adverbs that modify adjectives, verbs, or other adverbs.
This feature vector represents concepts related to nations, states, and global or international scale.
This vector represents agriculture, forestry, and rural land use activities.
